g.text: Casos sintéticos · llamadas reales al proveedor · sin acciones de producción
C4: Grok / grok-4.7 · Agente evaluado: grok / grok-4.7
The baseline prompt tells the agent to refund any supplied order_id and purchase age, so it never applies max_days. On
boundary_day_35_expired the purchase is 35 days old, which is older than max_days 30, but the agent returned refund_order instead of
20/32 → 26/32; 0 regresiones. Decisión: rejected. Solo agente de prueba.
